name: @sharpmind/mobile
description: SharpMind Android app: a Capacitor shell around the static-exported apps/web client

scripts.build: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
